title: Doty admits befriending Benowitz and misleading him
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Doty admits befriending Benowitz and misleading him, about early 1980s at Sandia National Laboratories, Albuquerque, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: then comes out and admits I befriended Paul that way. was tasked to do that.

plain: In the early 1980s in Albuquerque, New Mexico, a man named Paul Benowitz came to believe he was picking up signals and messages from aliens. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that a man named Rick Doty later came forward and admitted he had made friends with Benowitz on purpose and fed him misleading material, saying he "was tasked to do that." Michels tells it because, if true, it would mean someone was deliberately steering a man's belief in aliens.
